database.name: PostgreSQL
database.details: Primary database for client records, transactions, KYC documents, and sanctions screening

clients.columns: id, name, entity_type (individual/corporation/trust/partnership), jurisdiction, risk_rating (low/medium/high), onboarding_date, kyc_last_reviewed, pep_status (boolean), relationship_manager

transactions.columns: id, client_id, amount, currency, direction (inbound/outbound), counterparty, transaction_date, flagged (boolean), flag_reason

kyc_records.columns: id, client_id, document_type (passport/utility_bill/corporate_registration/financial_statement/trust_deed/source_of_wealth/pep_declaration), document_url, uploaded_date, expiry_date, status (valid/expired/pending_review/rejected), reviewer

sanctions_checks.columns: id, client_id, check_date, result (clear/hit/pending), matched_list, details

documents.name: SharePoint
documents.n8n_node_note: No native SharePoint node in n8n — access via HTTP Request node using Microsoft Graph API (https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/...)
documents.details: Internal document storage for KYC documents, compliance manuals, client files. Accessed via Microsoft Graph REST API.
